name: Enchanters
description: The Enchanters were a 1950s New York City youth street gang with documented factions in East Harlem (Manhattan), Astoria (Queens), and Corona (Queens). The East Harlem chapter, based around East 100th Street, was involved in a murder in February 1955. The Astoria Enchanters battled rivals including the Parkside Gents, Hobo Lords, and Queensbridge Projects gangs. The Corona chapter, which started in the late 1950s, included divisions known as the Little Enchanters, Baby Enchanters, Big Enchanters, and Lady Enchanters, and joined with the Chaplins to fight the Dukes in the 1961 Newtown High School battle.
